indexes.name: ca_stranded_fee_reconciliations_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ca_stranded_fee_reconciliations_pkey ON public.ca_stranded_fee_reconciliations USING btree (rake_record_id)

triggers.name: ca_stranded_fee_reconciliations_immutable
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER ca_stranded_fee_reconciliations_immutable BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE ON public.ca_stranded_fee_reconciliations FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION fn_ca_stranded_fee_reconciliations_immutable()
triggers.function_definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_ca_stranded_fee_reconciliations_immutable()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'ca_stranded_fee_reconciliations is append only' USING ERRCODE = '55000';
END
$function$

triggers.name: ca_stranded_fee_reconciliations_no_truncate
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER ca_stranded_fee_reconciliations_no_truncate BEFORE TRUNCATE ON public.ca_stranded_fee_reconciliations FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION fn_ca_stranded_fee_reconciliations_immutable()
triggers.function_definition:

  RAISE EXCEPTION 'ca_stranded_fee_reconciliations is append only' USING ERRCODE = '55000';
